newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's capital is shaken by a mild earthquake.
newsitem.headline: Chile's capital is shaken by a mild earthquake.

text.p: A mild tremor rocked Chile's earthquake-prone capital on Sunday night, but there were no immediate reports of casualties or damage.
Local radio stations reported blackouts throughout Santiago after the tremor, felt for 30 to 35 seconds at 8:24 p.m. EDT (0024 GMT).

The local seismological observatory could not immediately be contacted to determine the quake's intensity and epicenter, but initial reports pointed to the port of Valparaiso, northwest of Santiago, as its likely center.
Radio reports said people in Valparaiso, 74 miles (119 km) from Santiago, ran out of their homes because of the tremor. Blackouts were reported in some areas.
The quake was not felt near Chile's copper mines.
